fileDoc.summary: Proposed native map hierarchy for Azora.
fileDoc.description: Maps use operators supplied by their key and value types. There are no runtime hasher, equality, or comparator objects: - `HashMap<K, V>` and `LinkedHashMap<K, V>` require `oper#` and `oper==` for `K`. - `TreeMap<K, V>` requires `oper<` for `K`. - `containsValue`, structural `oper==`, and structural `oper#` instantiate only when the corresponding value operators exist. `oper[start:stop:step]` returns a snapshot of the map's entries using its iteration order. `start` is inclusive, `stop` is exclusive, and `step` defaults to `1`. The result is always a `LinkedHashMap` snapshot, preserving the observed iteration order even when the source is a `HashMap`. fileDoc.summary: Proposed native set hierarchy for Azora, mirroring `map.az` and `list.az`.

Every mutation receives `self!`, so a caller holding only a shared `ref Set<T>` view cannot mutate it. `LinkedHashSet<T>` is the single concrete pack implementing both specs.
